literal.prompt: Кто возглавлял большевиков во время Октябрьской революции?

finalGroupBindings.primaryGround: Presidential Library names Lenin as leader of RSDRP(b) and describes the October 1917 Bolshevik seizure; Stolypin had died in 1911; Kerensky opposed the Bolshevik takeover; Zhukov began military service in 1915 and is identified as a Great Patriotic War commander. This makes Lenin the unique answer.
finalGroupBindings.locator: L45-L50; Stolypin page L51; Zhukov page L48,L52-L55

finalGroupBindings.literal: После низложения Временного правительства II съезд Советов сформировал новое правительство — Совет народных комиссаров. Сначала в его состав вошли только большевики.
finalGroupBindings.primaryGround: The Presidential Library page says the Provisional Government was deposed and its ministers arrested, then states that the Second Congress of Soviets formed the Council of People’s Commissars as the new government and that only Bolsheviks initially joined it.

finalGroupBindings.literal: Пётр Столыпин — председатель Совета министров и инициатор аграрной реформы начала XX века.
finalGroupBindings.primaryGround: The official Presidential Library page calls Stolypin chairman of the Council of Ministers and says the 1906 decree initiated his agrarian reform.

finalGroupBindings.literal: По настоянию Ленина восстание началось ночью 24 октября (6 ноября).
finalGroupBindings.primaryGround: The note adds a concrete fact beyond naming the answer: at Lenin’s insistence the uprising began during the night of 24 October (6 November).

finalGroupBindings.literal: А. Ф. Керенский приказал закрыть типографию большевистских газет, но выполнить приказ не удалось.
finalGroupBindings.primaryGround: The page says Kerensky ordered closure of the Bolshevik newspaper printing house on 24 October and that the order was not carried out.

finalGroupBindings.literal: Георгий Жуков — советский полководец Великой Отечественной войны.
finalGroupBindings.primaryGround: The source identifies Zhukov as a Soviet commander during the Great Patriotic War and records his front command and Stavka roles.
